source: Report section 14: observed Kwentra weakness paired with the opening it creates

gaps.observed: Opaque pricing: no public list, quote-only, non-refundable, 60-day notice, no SLA
gaps.opportunity: Publish transparent per-room and occupancy-based tiers in EGP/SAR/USD with a real uptime SLA and monthly cancellation

gaps.observed: Dated front-end stack (Bootstrap 3.0.2, jQuery 2.0.3, Metronic 4.7.5) and hash-routed legacy app
gaps.opportunity: Modern responsive web app (React/Vue) with true mobile front-desk and housekeeping apps

gaps.observed: Dashboard and filtering complaints; regressions after weekly updates
gaps.opportunity: Live occupancy/rate dashboard, saved filters, staged releases with release notes; stability as a selling point

gaps.observed: Only 7 public reviews in 12+ years; zero on Capterra/GetApp
gaps.opportunity: Bake review collection into onboarding and support closure; 30 verified reviews would out-rank Kwentra

gaps.observed: 'Open API' claimed but no public developer docs
gaps.opportunity: Public, documented REST/webhook API from day one
Optional on-site go-live for resorts and a local-language WhatsApp support line

gaps.observed: Compliance moat: ETA, Ministry of Interior, ZATCA, Shomoos, NTMP
gaps.opportunity: Non-negotiable to match. Egypt ETA + guest reporting first, then Saudi ZATCA/Shomoos/NTMP; Hijri/Gregorian dual reporting expected

gaps.observed: Guest-facing layer thin: reputation and upsell partner-supplied until Reflectfy
gaps.opportunity: Native guest messaging (WhatsApp), digital check-in, upsell and review requests; entertainment/activities booking plugs in as differentiator

gaps.observed: Activities and add-on packages basic (link services to reservations)
gaps.opportunity: Real activities/entertainment module: schedules, capacity, animation-team programmes, guest sign-ups, resort programme publishing

gaps.observed: Growth lever is field workshops and referral commissions (USD 300 / 10%)
gaps.opportunity: Hotel-group workshops on the Red Sea, GM/F&B referral network, reseller deals with local IT integrators

gaps.observed: Multi-property is a headline feature sold to 20-hotel groups
gaps.opportunity: Multi-property from the start (schema-per-property or row-level tenancy)

gaps.observed: POS with recipe costing and procurement is a genuine strength
gaps.opportunity: Match F&B stock deduction and PO workflow; all-inclusive resorts treat this as core
